name: octaweave_share_file
description: Mint a public link for a file and return {url, inline}. THE URL IS RETURNED ONCE AND IS UNRECOVERABLE — only a hash is stored, so afterwards the API will only say `shared: true`. Save it immediately into whatever you are writing. `inline: false` means the file downloads rather than renders (PDFs, zips, and SVG always do), so do not build an around it.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
